newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's UDI bonds real return 6.77 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's UDI bonds real return 6.77 pct.

text.p: Mexico's UDI bonds were assigned at a price of 101.88852 UDIs and a real return of 6.77 percent at the primary auction on Tuesday.
Two weeks ago the UDI bonds had a real return of 6.88 percent and were assigned at a price of 101.62824 UDIs.
Demand this week was 1.15 billion UDIs compared to 400 million UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico with a bid-to-cover ratio of 2.88.
Two weeks ago demand was 1.29 billion UDIs with a bid-to-cover ratio of 3.69.
